data.name: TutorA
data.description: TutorA sits between students and tutors so no one has to guess. Every match is personally verified by our team.

mainEntity.name: Can I contact a tutor directly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not until a match is confirmed. Every introduction is made by our team — it keeps both sides safe and every match accountable. The moment you and the tutor both confirm, we release full contact details.
Browsing and requesting are free. TutorA charges a percentage-based success fee once a match is confirmed — never before.
Every tutor uploads qualifications and experience, which our team reviews before a profile goes live. Reviews from students are published openly.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will I be matched?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most students receive proposed tutors within 24–48 hours of submitting a request.

mainEntity.name: Is TutorA available in my country?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — we operate internationally, with multi-currency pricing and time-zone-aware matching for online tutoring.
